description: Global configuration for NTFYnext. Only System Managers can edit these settings.

fields.description: Master switch. When off, NTFYnext queues nothing and sends nothing.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Base URL of the ntfy server. Works with any instance, e.g. https://ntfy.sh or https://notify.company.com
fields.label: NTFY Server URL

fields.description: When enabled, EVERY outgoing notification email is also mirrored to ntfy for opted-in users (not just Notifications with 'Send via NTFY'). Off by default to avoid noise (OTPs, password resets, etc.).
fields.label: Mirror All Notification Emails

fields.description: Default ntfy priority (min=1 … max=5) when a notification does not specify one.
fields.label: Default Priority

fields.description: Comma-separated ntfy tags/emoji shortcodes, e.g. warning,skull
fields.label: Default Tags

fields.description: Default notification icon URL (shown by ntfy clients).
fields.label: Default Icon URL

fields.description: Default click-through URL applied when a notification does not set one.
fields.label: Default Click URL

fields.description: How to authenticate with the ntfy server.
fields.label: Authentication Type

fields.description: Verify the server's TLS certificate. Disable only for trusted internal servers with self-signed certs.
fields.label: Verify SSL

fields.description: Maximum automatic retry attempts for a failed push before it is marked Failed.
fields.label: Max Retry Count

fields.description: Topic to publish the test message to. Subscribe to it in your ntfy app to see the test arrive.
fields.label: Test Topic

fields.description: Publishes a test message using the settings above and shows the server response.
fields.label: Test Connection

fields.description: Optional backntfy admin-panel integration. When enabled, opting a User into NTFY auto-provisions an ntfy account and topic ACL on the backntfy-managed ntfy server.
fields.label: backntfy Auto-Provision

fields.description: Master switch for backntfy provisioning. When off, User.on_update takes no action.
fields.label: Enable backntfy Auto-Provisioning

fields.description: Base URL of the backntfy admin panel, e.g. https://backntfy.example.com. Not the ntfy server URL — that stays in Server URL above.
fields.label: backntfy URL

fields.description: Bearer token accepted by backntfy's API (the API_TOKEN env var on the backntfy container). Stored encrypted.
fields.label: backntfy API Token

fields.description: Checks that backntfy is reachable and that the API token is accepted.
fields.label: Test backntfy Connection

name: NTFY Settings
